case_name: Smt. Balbinder Kaur vs State Of Uttarakhand

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Balbinder Kaur, Jagdev Singh (mother-in-law and father-in-law)

facts_of_case: Petitioners are mother-in-law and father-in-law of respondent no. 2. They sought quashing of First Information Report registered at Police Station Bazpur, District Udham Singh Nagar.

legal_principles.principle: Abuse of process of law is not permitted.
legal_principles.held: It is argued that it is abuse of process of law on the part of the respondent no.2 to get lodged First Information Report by resorting to section 156 (3) of Cr.P.C.

legal_principles.principle: A petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution is a valuable right and should not be used as a counterblast to another proceeding.
legal_principles.held: It is contended that impugned First Information Report is counter blast to the petition filed by husband to the respondent no.3 against her under section 9 of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.

outcome.final_order: The petitioners shall not be arrested in connection with F.I.R No. 25 of 2013 during investigation, provided they cooperate with the investigating agency.

use_for_drafting: drafting a writ petition for quashing an FIR
advising on the application of IPC sections in divorce cases
assisting with drafting a response to a First Information Report
